en.short_summary: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image by Google DeepMind: fast native image generation and conversational editing for creative iteration and high throughput.
en.description_long: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image from Google DeepMind targets low-latency text-to-image and image editing. It supports natural-language targeted edits, multi-reference blending, and strong character consistency, with flexible common aspect ratios for marketing creatives, product visuals, and multi-turn ideation. Fast generation and high throughput make it a good fit for rapid iteration and lightweight batch image workflows.

zh.short_summary: Google DeepMind 旗下 Gemini 2.5 Flash Image：高速原生生图与对话式编辑，适合创意迭代与高吞吐出图。
zh.description_long: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image 由 Google DeepMind 打造，面向低延迟的文生图与图文编辑场景。支持自然语言定向修改、多参考图融合与角色一致性保持，并提供多种常用宽高比，便于营销素材、产品视觉与多轮创意打磨。生成速度快、吞吐友好，适合需要频繁试错与批量轻量出图的工作流。

en.short_summary: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image (Nano Banana 2) by Google DeepMind: Pro-level image quality at Flash speed, with text-to-image and conversational editing for high-throughput creative work.
en.description_long: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image from Google DeepMind—also known as Nano Banana 2—targets high-quality native image generation at mainstream cost and low latency. It supports text-to-image and image editing, multi-reference blending with strong character consistency, resolutions from 512 through 1K/2K/4K, and a wide set of aspect ratios. Improved in-image text rendering and prompt adherence make it a strong fit for marketing creatives, product visuals, infographics, and multi-turn ideation at scale.

zh.short_summary: Google DeepMind 旗下 Gemini 3.1 Flash Image（Nano Banana 2）：Pro 级画质与 Flash 级速度，支持文生图与对话式编辑，适合高效创作与高吞吐出图。
zh.description_long: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image 由 Google DeepMind 研发，亦称 Nano Banana 2，是面向主流价位与低延迟的新一代原生生图模型。支持文生图与图文编辑、多参考图融合与角色一致性，并覆盖 512 / 1K / 2K / 4K 等分辨率与丰富宽高比；画面文字渲染与指令遵循相对上一代 Flash 生图明显增强，适合营销素材、产品视觉、信息图与多轮创意迭代等高吞吐场景。

en.short_summary: Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image (Nano Banana 2 Lite) by Google DeepMind: the faster, more cost-efficient image tier for rapid iteration and high-volume generation.
en.description_long: Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image from Google DeepMind—also known as Nano Banana 2 Lite—is the speed- and cost-oriented tier in the Gemini image family. Built for ultra-low latency and high throughput, it supports text-to-image and lightweight image editing with solid character consistency and common aspect ratios. Output is optimized around 1K resolution, prioritizing usable quality at a friendlier unit cost—ideal for interactive prototypes, campaign drafts, batch lightweight generation, and fast multi-turn ideation.

zh.short_summary: Google DeepMind 旗下 Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image（Nano Banana 2 Lite）：更快更省的高速生图档，适合快速试错与规模化出图。
zh.description_long: Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image 由 Google DeepMind 研发，亦称 Nano Banana 2 Lite，是 Gemini 生图家族中偏速度与成本的档位。面向超低延迟与高吞吐场景，支持文生图与轻量图文编辑、角色一致性与常用宽高比；输出以 1K 为主，强调「够用的画质 + 更友好的单位成本」，适合交互原型、运营素材草稿、批量轻量出图与多轮快速打磨。

en.short_summary: OpenAI GPT Image 2: high-quality text-to-image and reference-based editing with flexible resolution and quality tiers for professional and commercial creatives.
en.description_long: GPT Image 2 from OpenAI is built for professional image generation and editing. It supports text-to-image, reference-based edits, and inpainting, with pixel-level size control and quality tiers (low / medium / high) to balance cost and detail. Strong multilingual prompt understanding and face preservation make it well suited for brand visuals, ecommerce imagery, illustration, and fine-grained retouching.

zh.short_summary: OpenAI GPT Image 2：高质量文生图与参考图编辑，支持灵活分辨率与质量分档，适合专业创作与商用素材。
zh.description_long: GPT Image 2 由 OpenAI 研发，面向专业级图像生成与编辑。支持文生图、参考图编辑与局部重绘，可按像素自定义输出尺寸，并提供 low / medium / high 等质量档以平衡成本与细节表现。多语言提示理解与人脸保持能力出色，适合品牌视觉、电商主图、插画与精细修图等商用场景。
